additional_regressions_resolved.icon_publication: The same real concurrent-writer fixture first exposed the non-atomic REPLACE_EXISTING unlink race. Two same-directory publication sites now use ATOMIC_MOVE, and unchanged assertions pass.
additional_regressions_resolved.cdp_command_ordering: A control now has at most one outstanding CDP command. Desired state coalesces while pending, completion commits the sent state and drains the newest desired state. Deferred-effect tests prove a late old command cannot win; failed unchanged state retries on the next explicit update.
additional_regressions_resolved.standalone_probe_linkage: Both standalone probe variants cross-link after adding the bcrypt dependency already required by shared WebView code; this receipt is a build/link proof, not probe execution.

ci_review.scope: Both standalone probes cross-build; YAML/PowerShell/fixtures and unchanged normal job/receipt predicates checked. Existing chooser/webapp suppliers retained, with no duplicate producer. Current source16 includes these bounded changes.
